title: Construction Happening Now in Mission Beach
description:
It's been a warm start to spring and if you've recently visited Mission Beach to cool off, you might have noticed this project. Construction crews have been hard at work to install a temporary lifeguard tower and trailer near the existing station to provide lifeguards with improved workspace while plans are developed to upgrade the 40-year-old structure.

A short portion of the boardwalk in front of the construction area will be closed Monday through Friday until Memorial Day, but a temporary path has been set up along the beach side of the seawall so you can still get through. Make sure to look out for detour signs!

#SanDiegoAtWork #MissionBeach
